```lean
intro n
let τ' := Complex.I * τ
let z := Complex.exp (↑Real.pi * τ' * ↑n ^ 2)
have h : Complex.re z = Real.cos (↑Real.pi * τ' * ↑n ^ 2).re
  := Complex.re_exp
have h2 : Complex.im z = Real.sin (↑Real.pi * τ' * ↑n ^ 2).re
  := Complex.im_exp
let z_abs_sq := Complex.normSq z
let z_abs := Complex.norm z
have h3 : z_abs_sq = (Complex.re z)^2 + (Complex.im z)^2
  := Complex.norm_sq_eq_re_sq_add_im_sq
simp [h, h2, h3] at h3
have h4 : (↑Real.pi * τ' * ↑n ^ 2).re = ↑Real.pi * ↑n ^ 2 * τ.im
  := by simp [τ', Complex.re_mul, Complex.re_I]
let θ := ↑Real.pi * ↑n ^ 2 * τ.im
let cosθ := Real.cos θ
let sinθ := Real.sin θ
let z_abs_sq_val := cosθ^2 + sinθ^2
have h5 : z_abs_sq_val = 1
  := Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
simp [h3, h5] at h3
rw [h3] at h3
have h6 : z_abs = 1
  := by rw [h3]; exact sqrt_one
let exp_neg := Real.exp (-Real.pi * τ.im)
let exp_neg_n_abs := exp_neg ^ n.natAbs
have h7 : Real.exp (-Real.pi * τ.im) = Real.exp (↑Real.pi * τ.im * -1)
  := Real.exp_neg_eq_exp_neg
let exp_neg_n_abs_val := Real.exp (↑Real.pi * τ.im * -1 * ↑n.natAbs)
have h8 : ↑Real.pi * τ.im * -1 * ↑n.natAbs = -↑Real.pi * τ.im * ↑n.natAbs
  := by simp
let exp_neg_n_abs_val2 := Real.exp (-↑Real.pi * τ.im * ↑n.natAbs)
have h9 : exp_neg_n_abs = exp_neg_n_abs_val2
  := by rw [h7, h8]; simp
have h10 : Real.exp (a * b) = Real.exp a ^ b
  := Real.exp_mul
have h11 : Real.exp (-↑Real.pi * τ.im * ↑n.natAbs) = Real.exp (-↑Real.pi * τ.im) ^ ↑n.natAbs
  := by rw [h10]; simp
rw [h9, h11] at h9
have h12 : Real.exp (-↑Real.pi * τ.im * ↑n.natAbs) = Real.exp (-↑Real.pi * τ.im) ^ n.natAbs
  := h11
have h13 : z_abs ≤ Real.exp (-↑Real.pi * τ.im) ^ n.natAbs
  := by rw [h6, h12]; exact one_le_exp _
exact h13
```
